raw_encoding.notes: Temp register: 2 bytes, MSB then LSB; lower 5 bits unused. 11-bit two's complement.

registers_or_commands.name: Pointer
registers_or_commands.description: Pointer register selects data register for write/read. Two LSB bits select register.

registers_or_commands.name: Conf
registers_or_commands.description: Configuration register. Contains a single 8-bit data byte. Default = 00H.

registers_or_commands.name: Temp
registers_or_commands.description: Temperature register. Contains two 8-bit data bytes. Stores measured Temp data.

registers_or_commands.name: Tos
registers_or_commands.description: Over-temp Shutdown threshold register. Contains two 8-bit data bytes. Default = 50 00H (80°C).

registers_or_commands.name: Thyst
registers_or_commands.description: Hysteresis register. Contains two 8-bit data bytes. Default = 4B 00H (75°C).

bitfields.name: OS Polarity
bitfields.description: 1 = OS active HIGH, 0 = OS active LOW (default).

bitfields.name: Temp data
bitfields.bits: MS byte B7-B0, LS byte B7-B5
bitfields.description: 11-bit 2's complement temperature data. D10 (MSB) to D0 (LSB). LS byte B4-B0 not used.

bitfields.name: Tos data
bitfields.bits: MS byte B7-B0, LS byte B7
bitfields.description: 9-bit 2's complement over-temp shutdown threshold data. D8 (MSB) to D0 (LSB). LS byte B6-B0 not used.

bitfields.name: Thyst data
bitfields.bits: MS byte B7-B0, LS byte B7
bitfields.description: 9-bit 2's complement hysteresis data. D8 (MSB) to D0 (LSB). LS byte B6-B0 not used.

init_sequence.notes: Power-up default state: normal mode, OS comparator, Tos=80°C, Thyst=75°C, OS active LOW, pointer=0. First conversion takes ~100 ms.
Wait ~100 ms for first conversion to complete before expecting valid temperature data.

read_sequence.notes: Set pointer to Temp (0x00), then read 2 bytes (MSB:LSB).
Combine the two bytes into a signed 16-bit raw value; only 11 significant bits (MSB D10..D0).

conversion_formulae.name: temp_conversion
conversion_formulae.formula: Temp (degC) = raw_signed_11bit * 0.125, where raw_signed_11bit is the 11-bit two's complement value packed in bits D10..D0 of the 16-bit Temp register.
conversion_formulae.notes: Canonicalized: exact compensation is preserved in formula/inputs, but the single-line integer expression was marked non-executable because it is too complex or not accepted by the safe expression evaluator.

conversion_formulae.name: limit_conversion
conversion_formulae.formula: Limit (degC) = raw_signed_9bit * 0.5, where raw_signed_9bit is the 9-bit two's complement value packed in bits D8..D0 of the 16-bit Tos/Thyst register.

inputs.name: raw
inputs.description: 16-bit Tos or Thyst register; lower 7 bits unused.

error_conditions.condition: I2C NACK during write or read
error_conditions.detection: Device does not acknowledge address or data byte.
Temperature conversion takes longer than expected (e.g., > 200 ms).

power_states.name: normal
power_states.description: Normal operation mode, temperature conversion every 100 ms.

power_states.name: shutdown
power_states.description: Shutdown mode, conversion disabled, I2C active, current ~3.5 µA.

evidence_spans.snippet: the other four MSB bits of the address data are preset to '1001'
only 11 significant bits should be used, and the 5 LSB bits of the LS byte are zero and should be ignored.
the temp-to-digital conversion is executed every 100 ms
Pointer register contains an 8-bit data byte of which the two LSB bits represent the pointer value
Configuration register table (Table 5) shows the bit assignments
If the Temp data MSB bit D10 = 0 then the temperature is positive and Temp value (°C) = +(Temp data) * 0.125 °C
only 9 bits of the two bytes are used to store the set-point data in 2's complement format with the resolution of 0.5 °C
SCL clock period 2.5 µs
At power-up, the device is put into normal operation mode, the Tos is set to 80 °C, the Thyst is set to 75 °C
The OS output is an open-drain output
Fault queue is defined as the number of faults that must occur consecutively to activate the OS output
Setting B0 to 1 will put the device into shut-down mode
The communication between the host and the LM75A must strictly follow the rules as defined by the I2C-bus management.

requires_human: A2, A1, A0 pin connections determine slave address; must be set per application.
Pull-up resistors on SDA and SCL lines are required; value not specified in datasheet (typical 10kΩ mentioned).
OS output requires external pull-up resistor; value up to 200kΩ recommended to minimize self-heating.
